name: SUPERMX
recent: Supermax 在截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的季度恢复盈利，营收环比和同比均大幅增长。公司将于 2026 年 12 月 7 日召开第 29 届年度股东大会，此外，联合创始人通过财产处置和债务偿还解决了投资工具的清算事宜。
notable: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度恢复盈利，营收环比增长 71.4%，同比增长 42.5%。
联合创始人通过财产处置和债务偿还解决投资工具的清算。
risks: 上诉法院驳回 Stanley Thai 干预 RM37m Sunimax Development 清算的申请。
联合创始人涉及的投资工具清算事宜。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 MYR 217.3 million，环比增长 71.4%，同比增长 42.5%；净利润为 MYR 80.322 million，净利润率 37.0%，上一季度净利润率为 -32.5%。

recent_en: Supermax returned to profit in the quarter ended 30 June 2026, with revenue rising sharply both QoQ and YoY. Separately, the co-founders settled the winding-up of an investment vehicle via property disposal and debt repayment.
notable_en: Returned to profit in the quarter ended 30 June 2026, with revenue up 71.4% QoQ and 42.5% YoY.
Co-founders settled the winding-up of an investment vehicle via property disposal and debt repayment.
risks_en: The appellate court dismissed Stanley Thai's bid to intervene in the RM37m Sunimax Development winding-up.
Winding-up matter involving an investment vehicle linked to the co-founders.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 217.3 million, up 71.4% QoQ and 42.5% YoY; net income was MYR 80.322 million with a net margin of 37.0%, compared with a net margin of -32.5% in the previous quarter.
